status: implemented protocol clarification; not official CLI acceptance

mcpItemId.meaning: ordinal of same original inventory response, not permanent identifier

clarifications.legacyWire: Older immutable wires have no management capability; new Rust emits capability and row enablement.
clarifications.readScope: get is selected cwd effective configured report, not current session connection/tools; exact writable source is proved independently by global and cwd config/read.

readLimits.note: Limits are per child except one action deadline; cleanup retains shared lease until actual child/group/pipes finish, not a guaranteed OS termination deadline.

clarifications.cancel: Original exact request only; after write dispatch cancellation cannot establish no write or rollback.
clarifications.profile: Highest writable User layer file; quoted literal MCP name under mcp_servers, no profiles key rewrite.
clarifications.configurationConcurrency: Official expectedVersion is not a cross-process CAS; fresh prechecks and complete semantic readback are bounded observations, not attribution of all concurrent writes.
clarifications.initialMismatch: inspect refuses configuredEnabled != fresh get.reportedEnabled with configurationChanged, and non-null disabled_reason with configurationReadOnly; either explicit desired value still requires these guards.
